input.subject: Re: Field trip fund - can we ask quietly?
input.body:
Dear Carlos,

Thank you for reaching out — please don't ever hesitate. Mateo is absolutely covered for the aquarium trip, and I've taken care of everything so you don't need to worry about it.

Your note stays between us, I promise.

Mateo is going to have a wonderful time! The aquarium is always a highlight for the kids.

Warm regards,

Maria Chen
PTA President, Jefferson Elementary
(This reply was drafted by ClubSteward, the PTA's agent — approved by a human)
